acceptanceCriteria.statement: Renaming a saved account must change only the CodexPill display label while preserving the saved auth snapshot, Codex identity, plan, and rate-limit data without invoking active-auth mutation.
Empty, whitespace-only, and case-insensitive duplicate rename inputs must be rejected without mutating the account catalog or auth state.
After a successful rename, the persisted account catalog must be sorted by display name without changing saved auth snapshots or account identity.

nonClaims: Does not prove native rename dialog presentation or text entry.
Does not prove live auth mutation or live Codex process state.
Does not prove remote host mutation.
Does not prove live macOS menu-bar behavior.
